description: Send your position to a meeting instead of your body — a one-page brief carrying your stances, fallbacks, red lines, tradables, and delegation limits, readable by the colleague (or agent) representing you. Use when you can't attend a decision-making meeting, when double-booked, when briefing someone to negotiate for you, or 'what would you need from me to represent me?'.
